entries.title: Move Together at Half Speed
entries.objective: Coordinate a group while deliberately reducing pace.
entries.animalRule: No one may overtake or leave the group; the pace stays conversational and safe.
entries.userBenefit: You practise social coordination during deliberate recovery rather than only during effort.
entries.mechanismConnection: Spinner Dolphin — Resting • Shallow • Half-asleep: The day is spent in a sheltered bay moving slowly in a tight group, with one brain hemisphere sleeping at a time so the animal never stops breathing or watching This Trial translates that low mechanism into one slow group loop.

entries.title: Move Together Without a Leader
entries.objective: Coordinate a small group using only neighbour cues.
entries.animalRule: No one may lead verbally; each person responds only to nearby movement.
entries.userBenefit: You feel how simple local rules can turn several people into one coordinated shape.
entries.mechanismConnection: Atlantic Herring — Each fish copies its close neighbours, which turns thousands of bodies into one moving shape. The Trial compresses that mechanism into one immediate, proofable human session.

entries.title: Move Toward One Target Edge-On
entries.objective: Make your approach less obvious by changing your angle.
entries.animalRule: Keep the same narrow approach angle until you reach the target.
entries.userBenefit: You discover how much visibility changes with angle alone and create an odd, memorable clip.
entries.mechanismConnection: John Dory — Presents a body so laterally compressed that head on it is almost a line, and approaches prey from that aspect before extending highly protrusible jaws into a tube that engulfs the target, so the attack is made by something the prey barely saw coming. The Trial compresses that mechanism into one immediate, proofable human session.

entries.title: Open One Sealed Package Without the Opening
entries.objective: Open One Sealed Package Without the Opening.
entries.animalRule: The intended opening may not be used, and the package must stay usable afterwards.
entries.userBenefit: You get a concrete, memorable result while practising grip then leap as a real human action.
entries.mechanismConnection: Tree Frog — Adheres with a wet mechanism in which a thin mucus layer between a patterned pad and the surface generates capillary and viscous forces, which works on wet leaves where dry adhesion fails and releases instantly when the toe is peeled The Trial compresses that mechanism into one immediate, proofable human session.

entries.title: Open One Stored Resource
entries.objective: Open One Stored Resource.
entries.animalRule: It must be something you already own and rarely open, and it must be used rather than inspected.
entries.userBenefit: Something you already own gets used instead of replaced, which is the cheapest upgrade there is.

entries.title: Open One Useful Access Point

entries.title: Pack One Final Route Without Returning
entries.objective: Pack One Final Route Without Returning.
entries.animalRule: The route is planned once and walked once; doubling back for a missed item ends the attempt.
entries.userBenefit: You practise committing to a one-way route instead of wasting movement on repeated returns.
entries.mechanismConnection: Undertakes a one-way breeding migration of several hundred kilometres to particular spawning grounds, where the adults spawn and die, so the fishery and the spawning stock are separated by an international boundary and by the migration itself

entries.title: Pack Six Soft Items Into One Bag
entries.objective: Complete six soft items into one bag as a one-off expression of Inflated Defense.
entries.animalRule: Use one calm attempt only; remain with the same setup until six soft items into one bag is complete.
entries.userBenefit: You turn inflated defense into a concrete one-off experience with a visible finish.
entries.mechanismConnection: Long-spined Porcupinefish — Drifting slowly • Crushing shells • Swelling if seized: Moves slowly on small fins and crushes molluscs and urchins with teeth fused into a solid beak, and when seized swallows water rapidly into a highly distensible stomach so the body becomes a sphere and the spines that lie flat on it stand out This Trial translates that low mechanism into one safe human action: Pack Six Soft Items Into One Bag.

entries.title: Pack Twenty Things as a Team
entries.objective: Turn many small jobs into one coordinated burst.
entries.animalRule: Everyone works on the same twenty-item goal until it is finished.
entries.userBenefit: You practise collective efficiency and turn a boring job into a fast shared win.
entries.mechanismConnection: Giant Honey Bee — Foraging • Layered • Working: A single open comb hangs in the open under a curtain of bees several bodies deep that shelters the brood and keeps it warm. Honey Bees gather nectar and pollen, live in highly organized colonies, divide labor, and use waggle dances to communicate the direction and distance of rich food sources. This Trial translates that mechanism into turn many small jobs into one coordinated burst.

entries.title: Paint One Bold White Band
entries.objective: Complete one bold white band as a one-off expression of Adaptive Mimicry Strategy.
entries.animalRule: Complete exactly one uninterrupted attempt; do not switch activities until one bold white band is complete.
entries.userBenefit: You turn adaptive mimicry strategy into a concrete one-off experience with a visible finish.
entries.mechanismConnection: Red-spotted Purple — A bold white band across both wings • No resemblance to any toxic species • Occurring north of where the model lives: Runs the non-mimetic white admiral form in the north, where the pipevine swallowtail does not occur, so there is nothing to imitate and the wing pattern is disruptive rather than deceptive This Trial translates that mid mechanism into one safe human action: Paint One Bold White Band.

entries.title: Pause between five deliberate breaths

Keep that limiting condition unchanged for the whole one-off action.
entries.userBenefit: You practise a concrete coordinated flight-shaped action through between five deliberate breaths.

entries.title: Peel One Dirty Layer Away
entries.objective: Peel One Dirty Layer Away.

entries.userBenefit: You get a visible reset by replacing the fouled surface instead of scrubbing everything.

entries.title: Photograph one object as three different moods
entries.objective: Photograph one object as three different moods.

Keep that limiting condition unchanged for the whole one-off action.
entries.userBenefit: You practise a concrete steady shell progress-shaped action through one object as three different moods.
entries.mechanismConnection: Apple Snail expresses Steady Shell Progress through this mode: Runs underwater on a gill in the right half of the mantle cavity, feeding on aquatic vegetation and detritus and closing the shell with a hinged operculum, which is the ordinary state while water is present and oxygenated. The Trial carries that same limiting structure into one concrete human action.

entries.title: Pick One Seat and Stay There

entries.animalRule: You have two minutes to choose, and must not scout at all for the next ten.
entries.userBenefit: You practise making one good site-selection decision and letting patience do the rest.
entries.mechanismConnection: Occupies one ambush perch and holds it for days or weeks at a time, returning to the same branch repeatedly, so the hunting strategy is site selection made once rather than searching repeated nightly

entries.title: Pierce One Barrier To Reach Inside
entries.objective: Pierce One Barrier To Reach Inside.

entries.userBenefit: You get in without wrecking the container, so it can still be closed and used again.

entries.title: Pin One Moving Target Fast

entries.animalRule: Use only a soft object and release within five seconds of reaching the final marker.
entries.userBenefit: You combine speed with a sudden precision demand instead of treating them as separate skills.

The Trial compresses that mechanism into one immediate, proofable human session.

entries.title: Place One Warning Before the Hazard

entries.title: Prepare One Thing Before Demand Arrives

entries.title: Prepare Tomorrow Before Tonight
entries.objective: Prepare one useful thing for tomorrow before the day ends.
entries.animalRule: It must be finished tonight and placed where tomorrow will actually find it.
entries.userBenefit: Tomorrow morning has one fewer decision in it, at a moment when decisions are expensive.
entries.mechanismConnection: Ili Pika — Cut-and-Cure Hay Stacking — Cutting • Curing • Short summer: Harvests alpine vegetation through a brief growing season and stacks it in rock crevices to dry before it can rot This Trial turns that mid-frequency mechanism into one thing for tomorrow.

entries.title: Preserve One Irreplaceable File Twice
entries.objective: Preserve One Irreplaceable File Twice.
entries.animalRule: The two copies must be genuinely independent; a second copy in the same place does not count.
entries.userBenefit: You reduce single-point failure for something you would actually care about losing.
entries.mechanismConnection: Persists almost entirely as managed breeding groups after the wild population was collected out, so the species now exists as a set of captive lineages whose pedigree management is the only thing maintaining it

entries.title: Press One Flexible Strip Into a Gap
entries.objective: Complete one flexible strip into a narrow gap as a one-off expression of Silent Ascent Strategy.
entries.animalRule: Complete exactly one uninterrupted attempt; do not switch activities until one flexible strip into a narrow gap is complete.
entries.userBenefit: You turn silent ascent strategy into a concrete one-off experience with a visible finish.
entries.mechanismConnection: Eastern Rat Snake — Wedging against bark • Gripping with belly scales • Reaching nests nothing else can: Climbs vertical trunks by folding the body into a concertina and pressing loops outward against the bark while the squared edges of the belly scales catch on it, which lets a heavy-bodied constrictor reach cavity nests that are safe from everything on the ground This Trial translates that mid mechanism into one safe human action: Press One Flexible Strip Into a Gap.

entries.title: Protect One Dry-Out Risk
entries.objective: Reduce exposure before it causes damage.
entries.animalRule: Change the environment so protection requires less ongoing effort.
entries.userBenefit: Builds preventive care and encourages solving environmental causes instead of repeatedly treating symptoms.
entries.mechanismConnection: Hippos spend daylight hours in water because their skin loses moisture easily and also produces protective secretions. This Trial translates that environmental protection into reducing one real exposure risk before damage occurs.

entries.title: Protect One Identity Boundary
entries.objective: Protect One Identity Boundary.
entries.animalRule: One rule, applied visibly to both; if you have to remember which is which, it has not worked.
entries.userBenefit: Two things that kept getting confused stop getting confused, permanently.
entries.mechanismConnection: Loses its identity through interbreeding with a domestic relative rather than through any decline in numbers, so the species can be disappearing genetically while the animals themselves remain visible and apparently healthy

entries.title: Protect One Small Project Until Done
entries.objective: Protect One Small Project Until Done.
entries.animalRule: No unrelated object may sit on that surface until the project is finished.
entries.userBenefit: A protected workspace gives one small project a real chance to survive.
entries.mechanismConnection: Keeps its eggs attached to a chosen surface and has the male fan and defend them continuously until hatching, which trades the enormous numbers of broadcast spawning for a far higher survival of far fewer eggs

entries.title: Protect Something Rare
entries.objective: Invest quiet maintenance in something valuable that is difficult to replace.
entries.animalRule: Put effort into preserving the limited thing you already have rather than replacing it.
entries.userBenefit: Builds stewardship and can extend the useful life of something scarce or valuable.
entries.mechanismConnection: Boeseman's Rainbowfish has a very restricted natural range, and demand for its distinctive colour pattern contributed to heavy collection pressure. This Trial uses that scarcity lesson by investing care in something valuable and difficult to replace.

entries.title: Pull Attention Away for Thirty Seconds
entries.objective: Redirect someone's attention from one harmless activity for thirty seconds, then reveal the distraction.
entries.animalRule: The distraction must visibly pull attention away from the original focus while the real objective remains elsewhere.
entries.userBenefit: Makes diversion strategy experiential: success comes from redirecting attention, not completing the obvious display.
entries.mechanismConnection: Killdeer expresses Broken-wing Bluff through this mode: Performs a distraction display in which the bird feigns a broken wing at a measured distance from the nest, adjusting its position and intensity to keep the predator following, then flies normally once the intruder has been led far enough away. The Trial carries that same limiting structure into one concrete human action.

entries.title: Pull One String From Under a Box
entries.objective: Complete one string from under a box as a one-off expression of Under-Clump Tunnels.
entries.animalRule: Use one calm attempt only; remain with the same setup until one string from under a box is complete.
entries.userBenefit: You turn under-clump tunnels into a concrete one-off experience with a visible finish.
entries.mechanismConnection: Sumatran Bamboo Rat — Cutting tunnel with the incisors • Reaching rhizomes from below • Pulling the culm down: Digs through soil with ever-growing incisors rather than claws, driving tunnels that arrive underneath a bamboo clump so the rhizomes and the base of the culm can be cut from below without the animal ever surfacing into the open This Trial translates that low mechanism into one safe human action: Pull One String From Under a Box.

entries.title: Pull Three Hidden Things From One Pile
entries.objective: Extract useful items from a messy layer without emptying everything.
entries.animalRule: Retrieve exactly three useful items without fully emptying the container or pile.
entries.userBenefit: You practise targeted retrieval instead of turning every search into a bigger mess.
entries.mechanismConnection: Common Bream — Extends highly protrusible jaws downward into a tube that reaches into soft sediment, drawing in mud with the prey, separating the two internally and expelling the sediment, which opens a food supply buried out of reach of any fixed mouth. The Trial compresses that mechanism into one immediate, proofable human session.

entries.title: Put Five Tiny Reserves Apart
entries.objective: Spread five small useful items across independent safe locations.
entries.animalRule: Each reserve must be separate; one lost location cannot remove all five.
entries.userBenefit: You reduce single-point failure by distributing small reserves instead of trusting one stash.
entries.mechanismConnection: Coal Tit — Stores food one item per site across thousands of separate locations and relocates them using spatial memory supported by a hippocampus that enlarges seasonally, which spreads the risk of theft across so many caches that no single loss matters. The Trial compresses that mechanism into one immediate, proofable human session.

entries.title: Put One Useful Thing Into the Group
entries.objective: Contribute one resource without needing to control the outcome.
entries.animalRule: Offer one useful contribution and do not require the group to use it your way.
entries.userBenefit: You practise contributing value without turning contribution into control.
entries.mechanismConnection: Cuckoo Wrasse — Runs the female phase, in which the fish is orange-red and unremarkable, spawns as one of many and invests in eggs, which is how every individual of the species begins regardless of what it becomes. The Trial compresses that mechanism into one immediate, proofable human session.

entries.title: Queue five errands in travel order
entries.objective: Queue five errands in travel order.
entries.animalRule: Preserve this Alpine Marmot constraint: Runs group hibernation in which the family huddles in a single chamber for six or seven months, with adults' periodic arousals raising the chamber temperature and subordinate members warming juveniles that could not survive the winter on their own reserves. Keep that limiting condition unchanged for the whole one-off action.
entries.userBenefit: You practise a concrete burrow calendar-shaped action through five errands in travel order.
entries.mechanismConnection: Alpine Marmot expresses Burrow Calendar through this mode: Runs group hibernation in which the family huddles in a single chamber for six or seven months, with adults' periodic arousals raising the chamber temperature and subordinate members warming juveniles that could not survive the winter on their own reserves. The Trial carries that same limiting structure into one concrete human action.

entries.title: Race One Braced Reach Against Loose
entries.objective: Prove that bracing beats hovering, against someone doing it the other way.
entries.animalRule: The braced person must stay in contact with their support throughout, and the other may not touch anything.
entries.userBenefit: Ten seconds that settle an argument about technique, and the answer is usually surprising.
entries.mechanismConnection: Crimson Sunbird — Takes nectar from a perch rather than in flight, using a decurved bill and a tongue rolled into tubes that draw liquid up by capillarity, which removes the enormous energetic cost of hovering and makes the same flowers worth far less energy to work The Trial compresses that mechanism into one immediate, proofable human session. This Trial translates that perched feeding instead of hovering into a race between a braced reach and an unsupported one.

entries.title: Race One Partner at Steady Pace
entries.objective: Win by sustaining pace rather than exploding once.
entries.animalRule: Start at a sustainable pace; an early sprint does not count.
entries.userBenefit: You get a competitive endurance burst where pacing matters more than one explosive move.
entries.mechanismConnection: Greater Amberjack — Carries a fusiform body, a narrow tail stalk and a stiff crescent tail driven by a high proportion of red aerobic muscle, which allows sustained high-speed pursuit rather than a single burst, so prey are caught by being outlasted. The Trial compresses that mechanism into one immediate, proofable human session.

entries.title: Race to Sort Ten Scented Cards
entries.objective: Complete ten scented cards quickly as a one-off expression of Turn Waste Into Signal.
entries.animalRule: Complete exactly one burst attempt within 12 minutes; stop immediately when ten scented cards quickly is complete.
entries.userBenefit: You turn turn waste into signal into a concrete one-off experience with a visible finish.
entries.mechanismConnection: Greenbottle Blow Fly — Detecting the volatiles • Arriving within minutes • Larvae done in days: Detects the sulphur compounds released by decomposition at long range and reaches a body within minutes of death, laying immediately so that larvae hatch and complete feeding in a few days, because the resource disappears as fast as it appeared This Trial translates that high mechanism into one safe human action: Race to Sort Ten Scented Cards.

entries.title: Rank Three Teammates by One Game
entries.objective: Complete three consenting players by one game as a one-off expression of Paper Order.
entries.animalRule: Complete exactly one uninterrupted attempt; do not switch activities until three consenting players by one game is complete.
entries.userBenefit: You turn paper order into a concrete one-off experience with a visible finish.
entries.mechanismConnection: Paper Wasp — Several females founding a nest together • Establishing rank through repeated dominance encounters • The top female laying while the others forage and build: Runs a society with no morphologically separate queen, in which reproductive rank among co-founding females is decided by physical dominance interactions and can change, so the division of labour is negotiated rather than determined at development This Trial translates that mid mechanism into one safe human action: Rank Three Teammates by One Game.

entries.title: Reach Five Objects Without Moving Seat
entries.objective: Complete five objects from one seat as a one-off expression of Long-reach Patience.
entries.animalRule: Use one calm attempt only; remain with the same setup until five objects from one seat is complete.
entries.userBenefit: You turn long-reach patience into a concrete one-off experience with a visible finish.
entries.mechanismConnection: Japanese Spider Crab — Walking slowly across deep soft bottom • Reaching food without moving the body • Carrying a shell far too small to shelter the legs: Grows enormously long thin legs on a comparatively small body, which gives a reach of several metres for foraging and a wide stable stance on soft sediment at the cost of legs that are fragile and cannot be protected This Trial translates that low mechanism into one safe human action: Reach Five Objects Without Moving Seat.

entries.title: Reach One Snack From the Far Edge
entries.objective: Reach One Snack From the Far Edge.
entries.animalRule: Both feet must stay behind the line; stepping round the table ends the attempt.
entries.userBenefit: You get a concrete, memorable result while practising quiet infestation as a real human action.
entries.mechanismConnection: Pantry Moth — Chews through the packaging that is supposed to exclude it, penetrating plastic film, paper and thin card either to enter a sealed packet or to leave one, so a container that looks intact provides no protection at all The Trial compresses that mechanism into one immediate, proofable human session.

entries.title: Reach Three Things From One Base
entries.objective: Choose one stable position and retrieve or touch three ordinary objects at different heights without relocating your starting point.
entries.animalRule: Your base may not move, and all three objects must be reached from it.
entries.userBenefit: You discover how much is within reach from where you already are, which is more than you set up for.
entries.mechanismConnection: Crested Gecko — A Tail Dropped Only Once — Climbing on adhesive toe pads and a gripping tail tip • Shedding the tail to escape a grip • Living the rest of its life without one: Uses a prehensile tail carrying its own adhesive pad as a fifth climbing limb, and can shed it to escape a predator, but unlike almost every other gecko it never regrows it, which makes the escape a single irreversible expenditure This Trial translates that mid-frequency mechanism into three objects from one base.

entries.title: Read One Touch Through a Spread Sheet
entries.objective: Feel where something moved without watching it happen.
entries.animalRule: Eyes stay closed until you have named the spot; one guess only.
entries.userBenefit: You find out how much information travels through a surface you would normally only look at.
entries.mechanismConnection: Labyrinth Funnel Weaver — Sheet Web and Tunnel Retreat — Waiting • Tunnelled • Hours: Sits inside a funnel at the edge of a horizontal sheet, reading vibration through the silk rather than watching for anything This Trial translates that vibration read through silk from a funnel into locating a touch across a spread surface.

entries.title: Read One Tray Without Touching It
entries.objective: Complete one tray without touching as a one-off expression of Grounding.
entries.animalRule: Use one calm attempt only; remain with the same setup until one tray without touching is complete.
entries.userBenefit: You turn grounding into a concrete one-off experience with a visible finish.
entries.mechanismConnection: Sea Pig — Walking on inflated tube feet • Reading the mud chemically • Facing into the current: Walks the abyssal plain on enlarged water-filled tube feet and locates the freshest organic material to have settled out of the water column by chemical cue, which is why whole aggregations are found facing the same direction on ground that looks featureless This Trial translates that low mechanism into one safe human action: Read One Tray Without Touching It.

entries.userBenefit: You practise a concrete red-plume ceremony-shaped action through one short sequence from memory.
entries.mechanismConnection: Raggiana Bird-of-paradise expresses Red-plume Ceremony through this mode: Maintains and revisits display leks, feeds in forest, and cycles between rest, foraging, and low-level social interaction around key trees. entries.userBenefit: You practise a concrete soaring perspective strategy-shaped action through after one task with five quiet minutes.

entries.title: Recover one dropped item using a reach
entries.objective: Recover one dropped item using a reach.

Keep that limiting condition unchanged for the whole one-off action.
entries.userBenefit: You practise a concrete comb-foot silk fling-shaped action through one dropped item using a reach tool.
entries.mechanismConnection: Cobweb Spider expresses Comb-Foot Silk Fling through this mode: Catches walking prey with tensioned gumfoot lines that release when touched and lift the animal clear of the ground, so the capture uses stored elastic energy rather than any action by the spider. The Trial carries that same limiting structure into one concrete human action.

entries.title: Recover One Dropped Object
entries.objective: Drop a lightweight object beside a chair, then retrieve it using a controlled reach without stepping into the marked 'water' area around it.
entries.animalRule: Your feet must remain outside the marked area; only your chosen retrieval method may cross it.
entries.userBenefit: Turns an awkward environment into a solvable retrieval problem by adapting movement instead of abandoning the target.
entries.mechanismConnection: Rice Grasshopper uses this mode by occupies a crop standing in permanent shallow water by swimming when it falls and laying its eggs above the waterline, which lets a ground-adapted insect exploit a habitat that is flooded for most of the year

entries.title: Recycle One Waste Into Fuel
entries.objective: Recycle One Waste Into Fuel.
entries.animalRule: Nothing new may be brought in: the only input is what the task has already produced.
entries.userBenefit: Something you were about to bin becomes the thing that finishes the job.
entries.mechanismConnection: Operates as a closed system that recycles urea nitrogen back into protein rather than excreting it, which is what allows months without water or elimination while muscle and bone are largely preserved

entries.title: Reflect One Light Patch With Foil
entries.objective: Complete one light patch with foil as a one-off expression of Silver Ascent.
entries.animalRule: Complete exactly one uninterrupted attempt; do not switch activities until one light patch with foil is complete.
entries.userBenefit: You turn silver ascent into a concrete one-off experience with a visible finish.
entries.mechanismConnection: Indo-Pacific Tarpon — Gulping air at the surface • Passing it into a lung-like swim bladder • Holding position in water too poor for gills: Uses a swim bladder lined with lung-like tissue and connected to the gullet, so it can take oxygen from air and occupy stagnant, deoxygenated backwaters that exclude fish depending on gills alone This Trial translates that mid mechanism into one safe human action: Reflect One Light Patch With Foil.

entries.title: Refresh One Worn Edge
entries.objective: Restore the working surface of a harmless everyday tool or object.
entries.animalRule: Change only the worn working edge, not the whole object.
entries.userBenefit: You extend the useful life of something by renewing the part that actually does the work.
entries.mechanismConnection: Snail — Feeds with a radula, a flexible ribbon bearing rows of chitinous teeth that is pulled across a surface like a rasp, and because the front rows wear away while new rows are secreted at the rear the tool is continuously renewed rather than maintained. The Trial compresses that mechanism into one immediate, proofable human session.

entries.title: Relay Chase One Rolling Object
entries.objective: Take a chase in turns so the thing never gets a clear run.
entries.animalRule: Only one person may be chasing at a time, and the handover has to happen while it is still moving.
entries.userBenefit: You find out how much easier a relay is than three people running at the same thing.
entries.mechanismConnection: Harris's Hawk — Relayed Flush and Ambush — Flushing • Relaying • Closing together: When a jackrabbit is put up, birds take the chase in turns while others cut the escape line, sustaining a pursuit far past the point any single hawk would have to break off This Trial translates that relayed pursuit with the escape line cut into a chase handed over while the object still moves.

entries.title: Release Five Small Things at Once
entries.objective: Release Five Small Things at Once.
entries.animalRule: All five must be released together, and the sort must start immediately.
entries.userBenefit: You turn a hidden reserve into a short coordinated burst of activity.
entries.mechanismConnection: Operates as a pelagic stage released in enormous synchronised numbers when temperature and food conditions cross a threshold, converting a hidden seabed population into a visible coastal bloom

entries.title: Remember a Quiet Route
entries.objective: Build a useful route memory without relying on your phone.
entries.animalRule: Use memory rather than navigation on the phone.
entries.userBenefit: Strengthens route memory and confidence moving through familiar places.
entries.mechanismConnection: Bornean Pygmy Elephants travel established river-valley routes and depend on long spatial memory. This Trial translates that low-energy navigation into quietly walking a familiar route and recalling its key points without digital guidance.

entries.title: Remove One Bright Clue From View
entries.objective: Remove One Bright Clue From View.
entries.animalRule: Only the bright clue may be removed; if anything else shifts between the two photos, start again.
entries.userBenefit: You get a concrete, memorable result while practising adaptive foraging strategy as a real human action.
entries.mechanismConnection: Black-headed Gull — Removes the conspicuous white inner surface of a hatched eggshell from the nest within minutes, because a broken shell beside a camouflaged clutch advertises the nest to crows and gulls searching visually from the air The Trial compresses that mechanism into one immediate, proofable human session.

entries.title: Remove One Hook That Makes Trouble
entries.objective: Remove One Hook That Makes Trouble.
entries.animalRule: Only the catching feature may be covered or moved; nothing structural may be altered.
entries.userBenefit: You prevent repeat damage by neutralising the part that makes withdrawal worse.
entries.mechanismConnection: Carries a rear-barbed venomous spine on the tail that enters easily and tears on withdrawal, which makes the injury far worse than the puncture and converts a defensive strike into a lasting wound

entries.title: Remove One Old Layer Completely
entries.objective: Strip away one obsolete layer before replacing it.
entries.animalRule: Only a genuinely removable old layer counts; stop before damaging the underlying object.
entries.userBenefit: You create a clean reset by fully shedding something obsolete instead of stacking another layer on top.
entries.mechanismConnection: Brown Crab — Runs the moult, in which the animal leaves the old shell entirely, expands by taking up water and then rebuilds a new one, during which it cannot feed, cannot resist any predator and cannot stand upright against a current. The Trial compresses that mechanism into one immediate, proofable human session.

entries.title: Reorder five home-screen apps by use
entries.objective: Reorder five home-screen apps by use.
entries.animalRule: Preserve this Underwing Moth constraint: Diversified by splitting along larval hostplants rather than by geographic separation, so dozens of nearly identical species occupy the same woodland and are separated by which tree their caterpillars eat. Keep that limiting condition unchanged for the whole one-off action.
entries.userBenefit: You practise a concrete hidden flash-shaped action through five home-screen apps by use.
entries.mechanismConnection: Underwing Moth expresses Hidden Flash through this mode: Diversified by splitting along larval hostplants rather than by geographic separation, so dozens of nearly identical species occupy the same woodland and are separated by which tree their caterpillars eat. The Trial carries that same limiting structure into one concrete human action.

entries.title: Repair one harmless loose everyday item
entries.objective: Repair one harmless loose everyday item.
entries.animalRule: Preserve this Geometer Moth constraint: Mimics a twig by gripping with the rear claspers alone and holding its whole body rigid and unsupported at an angle, which is possible only because the middle prolegs other caterpillars use were lost. Keep that limiting condition unchanged for the whole one-off action.
entries.userBenefit: You practise a concrete measured advance-shaped action through one harmless loose everyday item.
entries.mechanismConnection: Geometer Moth expresses Measured Advance through this mode: Mimics a twig by gripping with the rear claspers alone and holding its whole body rigid and unsupported at an angle, which is possible only because the middle prolegs other caterpillars use were lost. The Trial carries that same limiting structure into one concrete human action.

entries.title: Repair One Visible Break Before It Spreads
entries.objective: Fix the small visible damage that invites more of the same.
entries.animalRule: It must be visible damage rather than hidden wear, and the repair must be finished in one go.
entries.userBenefit: You stop one thing sliding from slightly damaged to not worth maintaining.
entries.mechanismConnection: Japanese Beetle — Feeding Beetles Call in More — Grubs feeding on grass roots for most of a year • Adults emerging and skeletonising leaves • Damaged foliage and feeding beetles drawing in still more: Feeds as an adult on leaf tissue between the veins while the combination of damaged-plant volatiles and a female sex pheromone attracts further beetles to the same plant, so feeding damage recruits more feeders rather than dispersing them This Trial translates that damaged foliage recruiting more beetles into fixing visible damage before it attracts more.

entries.title: Repair One Wool Item Before Damage Spreads
entries.objective: Catch a small fabric problem before it becomes a larger one.
entries.animalRule: Work only on a real small defect or real storage risk; do not cut or damage fabric for the Trial.
entries.userBenefit: You save one item from becoming a more expensive repair later.
entries.mechanismConnection: Clothes & House Moth — Maintains a gut at high pH with a strongly reducing chemistry that cleaves the disulphide bridges cross-linking keratin, which makes wool, fur, feathers and horn usable as food when almost nothing else can digest them at all. The Trial compresses that mechanism into one immediate, proofable human session.

entries.title: Replace One Harsh Warning
entries.objective: Replace One Harsh Warning.
entries.animalRule: The limit must stay exactly as clear as before; softening the boundary itself ends the attempt.
entries.userBenefit: The rule still holds, and the person reading it no longer feels told off by a fridge door.
entries.mechanismConnection: Replaces the black widow in urban habitats by colonising faster and by preying on it directly, and because it injects far less venom and bites far less readily, the replacement lowers the actual risk to people

entries.title: Replace One Missing Role Immediately
entries.objective: Replace One Missing Role Immediately.
entries.animalRule: The stand-in must work today without the usual holder; a plan to cover it later does not count.
entries.userBenefit: You keep a system moving by switching roles when the usual role disappears.
entries.mechanismConnection: Runs the male phase, reached by the largest female changing sex within days when the male disappears, an irreversible transition in which the gonad is reorganised and the fish takes over the harem it was previously part of

entries.title: Replace One Worn Layer Before Travel
entries.objective: Refresh the part of a frequently carried item that takes the most wear.
entries.animalRule: Renew only the worn protective or working layer, not the complete item.
entries.userBenefit: You extend an item's useful journey by replacing wear before it compounds.
entries.mechanismConnection: Willow Warbler — Undergoes a complete moult twice in each annual cycle rather than once, which is exceptional among passerines and replaces every flight and body feather before each long migration instead of asking one set to survive two crossings of the Sahara. The Trial compresses that mechanism into one immediate, proofable human session.

Keep that limiting condition unchanged for the whole one-off action.

entries.title: Resolve One Dispute By Display
entries.objective: Resolve One Dispute By Display.
entries.animalRule: The comparison must be visible at a glance; explaining it aloud ends the attempt.
entries.userBenefit: A stuck comparison resolves in seconds because it became visible rather than argued.
entries.mechanismConnection: Carries pigment patches on transparent wings that are displayed rather than merely worn, so territorial disputes over water are resolved by visual assessment instead of by the physical clashes that damage wings

entries.title: Rest One Group Task Before Restarting
entries.objective: Rest One Group Task Before Restarting.
entries.animalRule: Nobody may touch it during the stop, and everyone must restart together at the end.
entries.userBenefit: A stalled shared task restarts cleanly, because everyone stopped at the same point.
entries.mechanismConnection: Grasshopper & Locust — Runs the solitarious phase, in which individuals avoid each other, match their background in colour, move short distances and behave as ordinary grasshoppers, which is the state the great majority of the family remains in permanently The Trial compresses that mechanism into one immediate, proofable human session.

entries.title: Rest one hand completely for two minutes
entries.objective: Rest one hand completely for two minutes.
entries.animalRule: Preserve this Indian Pied Myna constraint: Turns a communal roost into a mechanism for spreading foraging information, because unsuccessful birds follow successful ones out at dawn, so knowledge of where food is moves through the group without being signalled. Keep that limiting condition unchanged for the whole one-off action.
entries.userBenefit: You practise a concrete shared dusk roost-shaped action through one hand completely for two minutes.
entries.mechanismConnection: Indian Pied Myna expresses Shared Dusk Roost through this mode: Turns a communal roost into a mechanism for spreading foraging information, because unsuccessful birds follow successful ones out at dawn, so knowledge of where food is moves through the group without being signalled. The Trial carries that same limiting structure into one concrete human action.

entries.title: Rest One Shared Project Before Restarting
entries.objective: Rest One Shared Project Before Restarting.
entries.animalRule: Nobody may touch it during the ten minutes, and the restart must be agreed together.
entries.userBenefit: Everyone restarts from the same point, so the first ten minutes back are not spent re-syncing.
entries.mechanismConnection: Mexican Paper Wasp — Abandons the colony and migrates to traditional overwintering aggregations, sometimes at a different elevation, where large numbers of future foundresses cluster together through the dry season before dispersing to found new nests The Trial compresses that mechanism into one immediate, proofable human session.

entries.title: Restore One Disturbed Patch
entries.objective: Choose one small messy or disturbed area and improve it using only materials already present there.
entries.animalRule: You may rearrange or reuse what is already in the patch, but you may not bring in replacement materials from elsewhere.
entries.userBenefit: A scruffy patch is visibly better using nothing brought in from outside.

entries.title: Restore One Useful Missing Step
entries.objective: Rebuild a useful habit that had stopped.
entries.animalRule: The routine must have been previously practised and then abandoned.
entries.userBenefit: You practise regeneration by restoring one useful missing piece and immediately see whether the larger activity works better.
entries.mechanismConnection: Chocolate Chip Sea Star — Regenerative capacity. This Trial translates that mechanism into restarting a dropped useful routine.

entries.title: Retrieve one item without moving two blockers
entries.objective: Retrieve one item without moving two blockers.
entries.animalRule: Preserve this Roadside Hawk constraint: Hunts from the boundary between forest and cleared ground, using cover on one side and visibility on the other, which makes the edge itself rather than either habitat the resource. Keep that limiting condition unchanged for the whole one-off action.
entries.userBenefit: You practise a concrete adaptable hunting-shaped action through one item without moving two blockers.
entries.mechanismConnection: Roadside Hawk expresses Adaptable Hunting through this mode: Hunts from the boundary between forest and cleared ground, using cover on one side and visibility on the other, which makes the edge itself rather than either habitat the resource. The Trial carries that same limiting structure into one concrete human action.

entries.title: Retrieve Something Without Your Hands
entries.objective: Solve a reach problem by inventing a better tool or angle.
entries.animalRule: Your hands may operate a tool but cannot touch the target itself.
entries.userBenefit: You practise mechanical creativity and leave with a compact problem-solving trick.
entries.mechanismConnection: African Harrier-Hawk — Clambering • Probing • Methodical: Legs that bend forward and sideways are worked blind into cavities other raptors cannot open. The African Harrier-Hawk's intertarsal joint bends backwards and sideways through roughly thirty degrees, letting it fold a leg into a tree hollow or the neck of a weaver nest and feel for nestlings it never sees. This Trial translates that mechanism into solve a reach problem by inventing a better tool or angle.

entries.title: Return to One Place You Promised Yourself
entries.objective: Go back to a location or practice you said you would revisit.
entries.animalRule: It must be a real previous commitment or meaningful place.
entries.userBenefit: You practise migratory fidelity and feel the quiet strength of returning rather than always starting over.
entries.mechanismConnection: Barnacle Goose — Migratory route fidelity. This Trial translates that mechanism into returning to a previously valued place or practice.

entries.title: Return to the Target
entries.objective: Practise repeated approach after being pushed away.
entries.animalRule: Return to the same target after every retreat.
entries.userBenefit: Builds repeatable persistence and the habit of re-engaging after interruption.
entries.mechanismConnection: A Black Horse Fly can return repeatedly to the same feeding wound after being disturbed. This Trial translates that persistence into approaching, retreating and deliberately returning to the same marker across multiple rounds.

entries.title: Reveal One Pattern Only From Angle
entries.objective: Make a hidden pattern appear from one viewing angle and disappear from another.
entries.animalRule: The arrangement must stay fixed; only the viewing angle may change between hidden and revealed views.
entries.userBenefit: You turn a distinctive animal mechanism into one useful, finishable real-world challenge.
entries.mechanismConnection: Swinhoe's Pheasant — Foraging • Orienting • Flashing: most of the male's colour is structural rather than pigmented, so it returns light only at particular angles, and the bird switches between reading as a dark shape on a dark floor and flaring metallic by how it stands relative to a light gap. This Trial translates that mid mechanism into one fixed pattern by changing viewing angle.

entries.title: Revisit Four Stations in Same Order
entries.objective: Complete four stations in same order as a one-off expression of Tiger-Stripe Notice.
entries.animalRule: Complete exactly one uninterrupted attempt; do not switch activities until four stations in same order is complete.
entries.userBenefit: You turn tiger-stripe notice into a concrete one-off experience with a visible finish.
entries.mechanismConnection: Hecale Longwing — Trap-lining the same flowers • Kneading pollen into a drop • Living for months: Collects pollen as well as nectar and works the grains externally with saliva to extract amino acids, which supplies the protein no other butterfly takes as an adult and lets it live for months rather than weeks This Trial translates that mid mechanism into one safe human action: Revisit Four Stations in Same Order.

entries.title: Rewrite one paragraph for a child
entries.objective: Rewrite one paragraph for a child.
entries.animalRule: Preserve this Velvet Swimming Crab constraint: Carries the last pair of legs flattened into oval paddles that beat to drive the animal through open water, which converts a bottom-bound walker into one that can cross gaps, pursue prey and relocate between refuges without exposure on the seabed. Keep that limiting condition unchanged for the whole one-off action.
entries.userBenefit: You practise a concrete velvet snap-shaped action through one paragraph for a child.
entries.mechanismConnection: Velvet Swimming Crab expresses Velvet Snap through this mode: Carries the last pair of legs flattened into oval paddles that beat to drive the animal through open water, which converts a bottom-bound walker into one that can cross gaps, pursue prey and relocate between refuges without exposure on the seabed. The Trial carries that same limiting structure into one concrete human action.

entries.title: Ride One Existing Momentum
entries.objective: Ride One Existing Momentum.
entries.animalRule: You must join the rhythm already running rather than setting your own.
entries.userBenefit: One useful thing done on existing momentum, for almost none of the effort of starting something.
entries.mechanismConnection: Migrates by moving with the winds ahead of weather fronts rather than by flying a route under its own power, which lets a very small animal cover continental distances on energy it never had to produce

entries.title: Roof One Thing With What Surrounds It
entries.objective: Build a cover for something using only the material already around it.
entries.animalRule: Materials must come from the immediate surroundings, and the cover must have a side entrance rather than lifting off the top.
entries.userBenefit: Something that was getting quietly damaged is protected, using nothing you had to find or buy.
entries.mechanismConnection: Western Meadowlark — A Roofed Nest in Grass — Weaving standing grass into a dome over a scrape • Entering along a concealed side runway • Singing from a post well away from it: Builds a roofed nest woven from the living grass around it with a side entrance and an approach tunnel, which hides a ground nest in open country where there is no cover above and no cavity to use This Trial translates that grass dome woven in place with a side runway into a cover built from what already surrounds the thing.

entries.title: Rotate One Layout Ninety Degrees
entries.objective: Reconfigure one small setup around a different orientation.
entries.animalRule: The whole layout changes orientation; simply turning one object does not count.
entries.userBenefit: You test whether a structural change can make a familiar setup work better.
entries.mechanismConnection: Turbot — Runs the adult form, in which one eye has migrated across the skull, the bones of the head have remodelled asymmetrically and the fish lies permanently on one side, becoming a bottom ambush predator that cannot revert. The Trial compresses that mechanism into one immediate, proofable human session.

entries.title: Run One Low Route for Three Targets
entries.objective: Run One Low Route for Three Targets.
entries.animalRule: The low stance must be held for the whole route; standing up ends the attempt.
entries.userBenefit: You get a concrete, memorable result while practising night focus strategy as a real human action.
entries.mechanismConnection: Little Owl — Hunts partly on the ground, running after invertebrates on unusually long legs rather than taking everything on the wing, which lets a small owl live on beetles and earthworms and occupy open farmland where large prey is scarce The Trial compresses that mechanism into one immediate, proofable human session.

entries.title: Run One Useless Thing Through a Process
entries.objective: Put something you cannot use through one step that makes it usable.
entries.animalRule: One process only; if it needs a second step it was the wrong thing to choose.
entries.userBenefit: Something bound for the bin becomes usable, and you get a sharper eye for what one step can rescue.
entries.mechanismConnection: Mound-building Termite — A Colony That Farms Digestion — Gathering plant material • Feeding it to a fungus comb inside the mound • Eating the fungus and the partly digested substrate: Passes collected plant material through a cultivated Termitomyces fungus growing on combs inside the nest, which breaks down lignin the termites cannot, and then consumes the comb, making the colony a farming operation rather than a chewing one This Trial translates that Termitomyces comb breaking down plant matter into one process that makes a useless thing usable.

entries.title: Sample Before You Commit
entries.objective: Compare several small options before choosing one.
entries.animalRule: Take a small sample from several options before committing to one.
entries.userBenefit: Builds better decisions by comparing broadly without overcommitting early.
entries.mechanismConnection: Goats use mobile lips to select individual leaves and sample many plants rather than cropping one patch indiscriminately. This Trial translates that browsing strategy into briefly sampling five options before choosing one.

entries.title: Save One Template for Three Future Uses
entries.objective: Save One Template for Three Future Uses.
entries.animalRule: It must work for three different future cases without being rebuilt for any of them.
entries.userBenefit: One piece of preparation becomes several future starts, reducing repeated setup work.
entries.mechanismConnection: Stores sperm from a single mating and uses it to fertilise successive broods over months, so a female that arrives alone in new water can found a population without any male present at all

entries.title: Say One Thing More Directly
entries.objective: Replace one vague sentence you would normally use with the clear version you actually mean.
entries.animalRule: One sentence is replaced, and the clearer version must say the thing you were hedging.
entries.userBenefit: The thing you meant is what the other person heard, first time.
entries.mechanismConnection: Pied Crow — Nesting on Structures, Not Trees — Building on pylons, poles and planted trees • Feeding along road verges • Spreading wherever both appear together: Uses human vertical structures as nest sites in open country that offers none naturally, and feeds on the carrion and waste that roads and settlements generate, so its range expands along infrastructure rather than along habitat This Trial translates that mid-frequency mechanism into one direct honest sentence.

entries.title: Scatter Then Gather Twelve Small Items
entries.objective: Complete and gather twelve small items as a one-off expression of Seasonal Gathering.
entries.animalRule: Complete exactly one uninterrupted attempt; do not switch activities until and gather twelve small items is complete.
entries.userBenefit: You turn seasonal gathering into a concrete one-off experience with a visible finish.
entries.mechanismConnection: Eastern Boxelder Bug — Feeding on seed • Scattered across the tree • Breeding through summer: Feeds through the warm months by piercing the developing seeds of boxelder and other maples with a slender beak, spread thinly across host trees wherever the resource is This Trial translates that mid mechanism into one safe human action: Scatter Then Gather Twelve Small Items.

entries.title: Scrape One Film Off While Wet
entries.objective: Take a built-up film off a surface using water and repeated passes only.
entries.animalRule: No chemicals; if the surface dries you must wet it again before continuing.
entries.userBenefit: One surface you had written off as stained turns out to have been merely coated.
entries.mechanismConnection: Flamed Tigersnail — Sealing the Shell, Shutting Down — Rasping lichen, fungi and decaying leaves from bark and litter • Gliding on a mucus trail • Working only while the air stays damp: Runs as an active grazer using a radula of thousands of chitinous teeth to scrape films of algae, fungi and decomposing plant matter, which requires the body surface to stay moist and therefore restricts activity to wet nights and damp weather This Trial translates that radula rasping films from damp bark into a film scraped off with water alone.

entries.title: Scrape One Safe Surface Completely
entries.objective: Complete one safe washable surface as a one-off expression of Persistent Cleaning.
entries.animalRule: Complete exactly one uninterrupted attempt; do not switch activities until one safe washable surface is complete.
entries.userBenefit: You turn persistent cleaning into a concrete one-off experience with a visible finish.
entries.mechanismConnection: Siamese Algae Eater — Working the surface • Rasping the film • Moving to the next stone: Holds itself against current and scrapes attached algae and biofilm off hard surfaces with a modified lower lip and horny rasping edge, working continuously over rock, wood and leaf rather than taking anything suspended in the water This Trial translates that mid mechanism into one safe human action: Scrape One Safe Surface Completely.

entries.title: Seal One Gap You Keep Losing Heat
entries.objective: Close one physical gap that has been letting something unwanted through.
entries.animalRule: The seal must be on the gap itself and must hold without being held.
entries.userBenefit: A room stops being cold, loud or dusty for the cost of ten minutes and something you already own.
entries.mechanismConnection: Flamed Tigersnail — Sealing the Shell, Shutting Down — Withdrawing into the shell • Sealing the aperture with a dried mucus epiphragm • Suspending metabolism until moisture returns: Runs a sealed dormant state in which the animal retreats into the shell and closes the opening with a hardened mucus membrane, cutting water loss and dropping metabolic rate for weeks or months of drought or cold This Trial translates that epiphragm sealing the shell aperture into one gap closed against what comes through it.

entries.title: Seal One Spill Before Cleaning It
entries.objective: Seal One Spill Before Cleaning It.
entries.animalRule: The ring must close before any cleaning starts, and nothing may cross it.
entries.userBenefit: You practise containment first: stop spread before spending effort on cleanup.
entries.mechanismConnection: Defends an open circulatory system with amebocytes that coagulate on contact with bacterial endotoxin, sealing an invader into a clot within minutes, which is the only defence available to an animal whose blood is not confined to vessels

entries.title: Seal Three Exits Before Finding Token
entries.objective: Complete three exits before finding token as a one-off expression of Burrow Strategy.
entries.animalRule: Complete exactly one uninterrupted attempt; do not switch activities until three exits before finding token is complete.
entries.userBenefit: You turn burrow strategy into a concrete one-off experience with a visible finish.
entries.mechanismConnection: American Badger — Digging the prey out • Sealing the exits first • Moving to the next colony: Hunts by excavating ground squirrels and pocket gophers out of their own burrows rather than pursuing them, plugging alternative exits with soil before digging so the animal underneath has nowhere to surface This Trial translates that mid mechanism into one safe human action: Seal Three Exits Before Finding Token.

entries.title: Search Five Hidden Spots Without Stopping
entries.objective: Search Five Hidden Spots Without Stopping.
entries.animalRule: The search must run continuously across all five spots without stopping between them.
entries.userBenefit: You turn constant active searching into a fast discovery game.
entries.mechanismConnection: Searches continuously and finds prey by collecting chemical traces on the tongue and reading them with a vomeronasal organ, which lets it detect concealed prey that a sit-and-wait lizard watching for movement would never see

entries.title: Search one folder using three different keywords
entries.objective: Search one folder using three different keywords.
entries.animalRule: Preserve this Great Green Bush-cricket constraint: Sings by drawing a hardened scraper across a toothed file on the opposite wing and amplifying the resulting clicks with a resonant membrane, so the song's pitch and rate come directly from the tooth spacing and wing movement. Keep that limiting condition unchanged for the whole one-off action.
entries.userBenefit: You practise a concrete bramble-leaf hue-shaped action through one folder using three different keywords.
entries.mechanismConnection: Great Green Bush-cricket expresses Bramble-Leaf Hue through this mode: Sings by drawing a hardened scraper across a toothed file on the opposite wing and amplifying the resulting clicks with a resonant membrane, so the song's pitch and rate come directly from the tooth spacing and wing movement. The Trial carries that same limiting structure into one concrete human action.

entries.title: Search One Place From Five Angles
entries.objective: Extract more value from one location by changing perspective instead of leaving.
entries.animalRule: Stay in the same place; change viewpoint rather than location.
entries.userBenefit: Builds curiosity and teaches how perspective changes what becomes available.
entries.mechanismConnection: Cozumel Coatis forage actively through complex ground and vegetation, probing many small opportunities. This Trial translates that exploratory flexibility into inspecting one place from multiple viewpoints.

entries.title: Seed One Protected Start
entries.objective: Place a small non-living token inside a sheltered container, add a removable 'reward' tab outside it, and photograph the seed-like setup.
entries.animalRule: The protected token must stay inaccessible from above while the removable outer tab remains easy to reach.
entries.userBenefit: Practises designing a protected core with an expendable outer incentive, separating what may be taken from what must survive.
entries.mechanismConnection: Gray's Leaf Insect uses this mode by produces eggs shaped and equipped like ant-dispersed seeds, so ants carry them into their nests, remove the edible part and leave the egg to develop in the safest place available

entries.title: Send One Low Signal Across Distance
entries.objective: Complete one low signal across distance as one visible expression of Blue Helmet Signal.
entries.animalRule: Exactly one attempt is allowed, and the result must preserve this constraint: walking, booming, rarely breeding.
entries.userBenefit: You practise blue helmet signal through the unusual constraint of one low signal across distance.
entries.mechanismConnection: Helmeted Curassow — Walking • Booming • Rarely breeding: A large greyish-blue casque sits on the forehead of a bird whose signal is a deep, almost subsonic boom, and both the casque and the call are suited to cloud forest where high sound is absorbed within metres but very low sound keeps travelling This Trial translates that mechanism into the one-off action “Send One Low Signal Across Distance”.

entries.title: Send One Message Using Colour Alone
entries.objective: Send One Message Using Colour Alone.
entries.animalRule: Only the colour may carry the message; a single word or gesture ends the attempt.
entries.userBenefit: You test whether a visual display can carry social information without words.
entries.mechanismConnection: Changes colour primarily to signal to other chameleons rather than to match its background, so the display is directed at a viewer and the intensity tracks who is watching rather than where the animal is sitting

entries.title: Separate mixed items into keep move discard
entries.objective: Separate mixed items into keep move discard.
entries.animalRule: Preserve this Common Myna constraint: Acquires nest sites by taking them from other cavity-nesting birds and mammals rather than by finding unused ones, removing eggs and young in the process, which converts a limited resource into one it controls. Keep that limiting condition unchanged for the whole one-off action.
entries.userBenefit: You practise a concrete pavement pickings-shaped action through mixed items into keep move discard.
entries.mechanismConnection: Common Myna expresses Pavement Pickings through this mode: Acquires nest sites by taking them from other cavity-nesting birds and mammals rather than by finding unused ones, removing eggs and young in the process, which converts a limited resource into one it controls. The Trial carries that same limiting structure into one concrete human action.

entries.title: Sequence Four Process Steps 2
entries.objective: Write or photograph four steps of one ordinary process in the correct order.
entries.animalRule: Preserve this Gray Wolf constraint: Commits the group to a small fraction of the animals tested, against prey many times a wolf's weight that can and does kill wolves with hooves and antlers, which makes the decision to engage the most expensive one the pack makes. Keep that limiting condition unchanged for the whole one-off action.
entries.userBenefit: You practise noticing structure and turning a biological pattern into one clear, finishable arrangement.
entries.mechanismConnection: Gray Wolf expresses Cooperation through this mode: Commits the group to a small fraction of the animals tested, against prey many times a wolf's weight that can and does kill wolves with hooves and antlers, which makes the decision to engage the most expensive one the pack makes. The Trial carries that same limiting structure into one concrete human action.

entries.title: Sequence six ingredients before cooking
entries.objective: Sequence six ingredients before cooking.
entries.animalRule: Preserve this Redwing constraint: Migrates in darkness and maintains flock cohesion with a thin high-pitched flight call repeated through the night, which allows birds that cannot see each other to stay together and to follow a route without any visual contact. Keep that limiting condition unchanged for the whole one-off action.
entries.userBenefit: You practise a concrete nightpassage-shaped action through six ingredients before cooking.
entries.mechanismConnection: Redwing expresses Nightpassage through this mode: Migrates in darkness and maintains flock cohesion with a thin high-pitched flight call repeated through the night, which allows birds that cannot see each other to stay together and to follow a route without any visual contact. The Trial carries that same limiting structure into one concrete human action.

entries.title: Set One Marker That Sticks to Handlers
entries.objective: Leave something on a shared object that transfers to whoever picks it up.
entries.animalRule: The marker must be harmless and must come away on handling rather than staying put.
entries.userBenefit: You find out where a wandering shared thing actually goes, without asking anyone.
entries.mechanismConnection: Orange Moth — Detachable Spines That Gum Jaws — Carrying a coat of translucent gelatinous spines • Shedding them on contact • Leaving an attacker with jaws stuck together: Covers the larva in soft, transparent, gelatinous appendages that detach easily and adhere to whatever touches them, so an ant that bites is left with its mouthparts fouled instead of a caterpillar in them This Trial translates that coat of detachable gelatinous spines into a marker that transfers onto whoever handles the thing.

entries.title: Set One Tell-Tale That Shows Tampering
entries.objective: Rig something so that any interference is obvious at a glance.
entries.animalRule: The tell-tale must be undetectable to a casual user and unmistakable to you.
entries.userBenefit: You finally know whether the thing is being touched, without accusing anyone or installing anything.
entries.mechanismConnection: Black Skirt Tetra — Alarm Chemical Released by Injury — Shoaling loosely while feeding • Releasing alarm chemical when skin is torn • Contracting the whole shoal within seconds: Carries a chemical in specialised skin cells that is released only when the skin is damaged, so any successful attack instantly informs every fish nearby, and the shoal responds before the second strike arrives This Trial translates that alarm chemical released only when skin tears into a marker that fires only on interference.

entries.title: Set One Visible Signal of Your State
entries.objective: Put up a sign that tells people how available you are without you having to say it.
entries.animalRule: It must be readable at a glance from a distance, with nothing to interpret.
entries.userBenefit: Interruptions drop sharply and nobody has to guess whether now is a bad moment.
entries.mechanismConnection: Cockatiel — A Crest That Reports Arousal — Raising and lowering a mobile crest • Signalling alarm, interest or calm continuously • Reading the same signal in others: Carries a mobile feather crest whose position is driven by arousal rather than intention, which broadcasts the bird's internal state constantly to flockmates in an open landscape where birds are often out of each other's sight This Trial translates that arousal-driven mobile crest into a state indicator others can read at a glance.

entries.title: Set Up Your Best Environment
entries.objective: Invest a few calm minutes in making one place easier to work in.
entries.animalRule: Adapt the environment before forcing yourself to work harder.
entries.userBenefit: Leaves you with a better environment for future focused work.
entries.mechanismConnection: Some Arctic Char remain in cold lakes for life and mature on the resources available there when migration to richer feeding grounds is unavailable. This Trial translates that fit-to-place strategy into improving one environment before demanding more effort from yourself.

entries.title: Shade one drawing using three values
entries.objective: Shade one drawing using three values.
entries.animalRule: Preserve this Mule Deer constraint: Moves by stotting, launching from all four feet simultaneously, which sacrifices flat-ground speed for the ability to clear obstacles and change direction entirely at every landing in terrain a running animal cannot cross. Keep that limiting condition unchanged for the whole one-off action.
entries.userBenefit: You practise a concrete adaptive movement pattern-shaped action through one drawing using three values.
entries.mechanismConnection: Mule Deer expresses Adaptive Movement Pattern through this mode: Moves by stotting, launching from all four feet simultaneously, which sacrifices flat-ground speed for the ability to clear obstacles and change direction entirely at every landing in terrain a running animal cannot cross. The Trial carries that same limiting structure into one concrete human action.

entries.title: Shape Three Sounds With One Tool
entries.objective: Shape Three Sounds With One Tool.
entries.animalRule: Only tongue and mouth position may change; volume and pace must stay the same across all three.
entries.userBenefit: You hear how much of being understood is tongue position rather than volume.
entries.mechanismConnection: Uses a thick muscular tongue as a manipulator inside the mouth, positioning food against the bill and shaping sound from the syrinx, so one organ does the work that hands and lips do in other animals

entries.title: Share One Resource Without Taking Over
entries.objective: Share One Resource Without Taking Over.
entries.animalRule: You may not finish any part of it for them; the resource is all you give.
entries.userBenefit: Someone finishes their own task with your help, and keeps the credit and the skill.
entries.mechanismConnection: Parasitises babbler nests without evicting the host's own young, competing with them for food instead, which lets the host raise some of its own brood and reduces the pressure to reject the parasite

entries.title: Share One Snack Across Four Stops
entries.objective: Complete one snack across four stops as a one-off expression of Adaptability.
entries.animalRule: Complete exactly one uninterrupted attempt; do not switch activities until one snack across four stops is complete.
entries.userBenefit: You turn adaptability into a concrete one-off experience with a visible finish.
entries.mechanismConnection: House Sparrow — Feeding on spilled grain • Nesting in a building cavity • Roosting as a flock: Lives on what agriculture and buildings produce, with a digestive shift toward starch and a bill shaped for seed rather than insects, nesting in gaps in masonry and eaves that no natural habitat supplies in the same density This Trial translates that mid mechanism into one safe human action: Share One Snack Across Four Stops.

entries.title: Share the Watch
entries.objective: Keep working while a partner temporarily monitors what you would normally check yourself.
entries.animalRule: The watcher owns the agreed monitoring job so the worker does not keep checking it.
entries.userBenefit: Builds trust, focus and shared responsibility.
entries.mechanismConnection: Sheep have a very wide field of view and also benefit from flock vigilance, allowing individuals to spend more time feeding while neighbours help detect danger. This Trial translates that shared monitoring into alternating a watcher role so each person gets uninterrupted focus.

entries.title: Show One Warning Before You Start
entries.objective: Show One Warning Before You Start.
entries.animalRule: The limit must be stated before the activity starts, not once it becomes a problem.
entries.userBenefit: A visible warning prevents avoidable friction before it begins.
entries.mechanismConnection: Operates as a conspicuous diurnal grazer whose bold pattern advertises the venomous dorsal and anal spines to anything considering an attack

entries.title: Shrink One Hot Task Into Shade
entries.objective: Reduce exposure instead of abandoning the task.
entries.animalRule: The task must stay the same; change exposure, not the goal.
entries.userBenefit: You practise solving environmental friction with positioning rather than extra effort.
entries.mechanismConnection: Scarlet Skimmer — Obelisk • Vertical • Cooling: In the hottest part of the day it points its abdomen directly at the sun, reducing the area exposed to almost nothing and cutting heat load without leaving the territory This Trial translates that low mechanism into one task to reduce heat exposure.

entries.title: Shrink One Plan Until It Can Start
entries.objective: Shrink One Plan Until It Can Start.
entries.animalRule: It must be shrunk until it can be finished within the ten minutes, and then finished.
entries.userBenefit: You trade scale for survivability and leave with a finished first version instead of a grand stalled plan.
entries.mechanismConnection: Matures in a few years and stays small, which is the opposite of the sturgeon pattern and the reason this is the one species in the family that can be farmed, hybridised and used to restock rivers on a practical timescale

entries.title: Sidestep Around Six Floor Markers
entries.objective: Complete around six floor markers as a one-off expression of Webless Pursuit.
entries.animalRule: Complete exactly one burst attempt within 12 minutes; stop immediately when around six floor markers is complete.
entries.userBenefit: You turn webless pursuit into a concrete one-off experience with a visible finish.
entries.mechanismConnection: Huntsman Spider — Waiting flat against a vertical surface • Running sideways on laterigrade legs • Seizing prey directly with no web involved: Carries legs that articulate to project sideways rather than beneath the body, which keeps the animal flat enough to occupy narrow crevices and lets it move fast in any direction across a surface without turning first This Trial translates that high mechanism into one safe human action: Sidestep Around Six Floor Markers.

entries.title: Sidestep between six floor markers
entries.objective: Sidestep between six floor markers.
entries.animalRule: Preserve this Woodlouse constraint: Carries a fluid-filled brood pouch in which the eggs complete the aquatic phase of development, which is how a crustacean reproduces on land without ever returning to water. Keep that limiting condition unchanged for the whole one-off action.
entries.userBenefit: You practise a concrete moisture seeking-shaped action through between six floor markers.
entries.mechanismConnection: Woodlouse expresses Moisture Seeking through this mode: Carries a fluid-filled brood pouch in which the eggs complete the aquatic phase of development, which is how a crustacean reproduces on land without ever returning to water. The Trial carries that same limiting structure into one concrete human action.

entries.title: Sift One Cup of Rice for Tokens
entries.objective: Complete one cup of rice for tokens as a one-off expression of Soil Aeration.
entries.animalRule: Use one calm attempt only; remain with the same setup until one cup of rice for tokens is complete.
entries.userBenefit: You turn soil aeration into a concrete one-off experience with a visible finish.
entries.mechanismConnection: Green June Beetle — Living as a grub in decaying soil organic matter • Crawling on its back • Emerging briefly as an adult: Spends almost its whole life underground as a larva processing decayed plant material, so the visible beetle is a short reproductive phase at the end of a long buried feeding stage This Trial translates that low mechanism into one safe human action: Sift One Cup of Rice for Tokens.

entries.title: Sift One Tray for Hidden Pieces
entries.objective: Separate useful small pieces from a harmless mixed material.
entries.animalRule: Recover the hidden objects through sifting; hand-picking them individually does not count.
entries.userBenefit: You turn separation by filtering into a satisfying recovery challenge.
entries.mechanismConnection: Gray Whale — Feeds by rolling onto its side, suctioning sediment from the seabed and filtering amphipods out of it through unusually short coarse baleen, which is the only baleen whale to feed on the bottom and which reworks the seafloor as it goes. The Trial compresses that mechanism into one immediate, proofable human session.

entries.title: Signal One Direction Without Words
entries.objective: Guide another person using one visible directional cue.
entries.animalRule: Use one consistent visual signal and no spoken directions during the attempt.
entries.userBenefit: You test how clearly one conspicuous cue can coordinate movement without language.
entries.mechanismConnection: White-tailed Deer — Raises and flares a tail whose underside is bright white when it detects a predator and keeps it raised while fleeing, which alerts other deer, signals to the predator that it has been seen, and gives following fawns something to follow in dense cover. The Trial compresses that mechanism into one immediate, proofable human session.
